limits: Decisions come from candidate code with an in-process fake transport; proxy, raw-socket or subprocess network bypass is not tested (OS or firewall enforcement belongs to M1-03).

Sanitiser patterns are a candidate ruleset (R-06/sanitize-v2), not a complete sensitive-data or prompt-injection detector: unlabelled high-entropy strings, paraphrased instructions and cross-script homoglyphs can pass.
Absolute POSIX paths are detected only under the listed roots followed by a segment; a bare root mention and a path under an unlisted root are not detected.
Text fields, URLs and queries above their length bounds are refused rather than scanned or truncated.
Approval records are synthetic and unauthenticated.
The accept-phase profile and M1-02 policy record are not bound yet.
Independent review was an automated reviewer agent, not a human reviewer.
